name: ui-layouts-carousel
blurb: Embla-carousel with context, providing prev/next buttons, dots, and snaps display.
description: Compound carousel system built on embla-carousel. Includes Carousel context provider, SliderContainer, Slider items, navigation buttons (prev/next), dot indicators, and snap counter. Supports vertical or horizontal orientation, looping, and scale effects.
use_when: Building a featured carousel with full control over layout, navigation, and indicators.
avoid_when: Simple image galleries—the context-based architecture requires multiple sub-components.
a11y: Keyboard navigation (arrow keys, respects RTL direction). Previous/next buttons disable appropriately. Dot buttons have implied labels via carousel.js conventions. No ARIA labels for custom buttons.
